title: Ecology
description: No creature lives alone: predators and prey, grazers and plants, rise and fall around each other. Unlocks the Ecosphere.

puzzle.goal: Prey grow at rate a and are eaten at rate b per predator. With y predators about, write the prey's net growth rate G.
puzzle.name: Net birth
puzzle.ask: Find G for a = @{a}, b = @{b} and y = @{y}.
puzzle.method: Births minus what the predators take; it is zero at the balance y = a/b, where the prey hold steady.
